title: CRISPR screens decode cancer cell pathways that trigger γδ T cell detection
model: Daudi-Cas9 Burkitt lymphoma cells, genome-wide knockout library (90,709 guides), co-culture with Vγ9Vδ2 T cells
contrast: Survivors of γδ T cell co-culture (3 donors) vs pre-kill library (3 vs 1)
paper_calls: 71 enriched genes at FDR 0.10 (BTN3A1, SPIB, IRF1, FBXW7, BTN2A1, NLRC5 at the top); 1,912 depleted, mostly fitness genes
barcs_calls: 120 enriched genes at FDR 0.10 (2,335 depleted, mostly fitness genes); no control guides for a control null
named_hits: 7/7 at FDR 0.10; enriched ranks BTN3A1 #1, SPIB #2, IRF1 #3, BTN2A1 #5, BTN3A2 #7, NLRC5 #9, HMGCR #64
verdict: BARCS reproduces the paper's resistance hits almost exactly (same top four, 60 of 71 enriched calls, rank correlation 0.80) and adds 60 modest interferon, MHC and sterol genes; calibration could not be checked because the library has no control guides.
